{{Top|leg}}
The '''unipod''' was part of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], hanging below the city proper. It was equipped with thirty-two [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]] that were directed to draw [[spin-sealed]] [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] out of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and into the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
